provenance.forecasts: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API (https://previous-runs-api.open-meteo.com) — model output as issued N days before each target day, hourly, aggregated to UTC days (all 24 hours required).
provenance.truth: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo Archive API (models=era5), hourly, aggregated identically.
provenance.climatology: ERA5 daily 2019–2024, all days within ±7 days of the target calendar day.
provenance.reproducibility: npx tsx research/weather-benchmark.ts --offline (from research/cache) — deterministic seeds.

caveats: ERA5 is a reanalysis at ~31 km resolution, not station truth; point forecasts are verified against the ERA5 grid cell, which favours smooth models and understates local extremes.
Single grid points stand in for each region; production-weighted areal averages would score differently (areal averages are usually more predictable).
Previous-Runs data are the stitched output of successive runs N days earlier, so a "day-3" forecast mixes run times within the target day.
One year of evaluation covers one realisation of each season; skill differences between seasons and years are not resolved.
Diebold–Mariano tests use the cross-site daily mean loss; sites are not independent, so the effective sample is the number of days.
